_instructions: This scaffold is intentionally a pre-port checklist, not parity evidence.
Keep status DRAFT_PRE_PORT until a separate CubeWBA project, WBA build wrapper, WBA BLE adapter, scheduler hook, and target-named panel adapter exist.
Use the listed invariants to review the WBA branch before claiming it matches WB55 behavior.
Generate the target panel evidence record separately and keep it failing until real controller, pin, timing, BLE, and visual evidence are filled.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not copy WB55 CPU2/FUS/IPCC/HSEM/STM32_WPAN mechanics into WBA portable files.
Do not rename a WB55 adapter as WBA without a separate CubeWBA build and real validation.
Do not use WBA65-only resources unless the WBA55-safe contract still passes or a capability flag gates the expansion.
Do not move panel SPI/GPIO/reset/BUSY timing into ExpressionV1, display_queue, or panel_adapter portable files.
Do not put a physical flash address, erase/write routine, or active-pack switch into the portable asset store or its WBA read adapter.
parity_exit_criteria: WBA build wrapper passes for the selected target.
The no-hardware screen acceptance suite passes with WBA platform code added.
Display drain contract stays passing after WBA display task and panel transport are added.
Target capability profile stays WBA55-safe before any WBA65-only resource or larger shared limit is used.
Expression visual and layout contracts stay passing after WBA platform code is added.
Expression priority matrix stays passing after WBA scheduler or status-adapter code is added.
Expression input source matrix stays passing after WBA status adapters are added.
Real BLE bench carries screen_expression_status baseline and preserves accepted/final CardStatusV1 identity for card_write and settings_sleepy_screen_status.
Panel evidence record passes with a *_stm32wba.* adapter file, real panel timing, clean portability notes, and visual proof.

portable_invariants.card_status_contract: accepted/rendered/failed/busy render states and stable last_error values are host-facing.
portable_invariants.display_drain_contract: tools/verify_expression_display_drain.py guards one-request-per-pass display drain, target panel refresh, runtime diagnostics before final CardStatusV1, and pending-work reschedule behavior.
portable_invariants.expression_copy_contract: tools/verify_expression_copy_contract.py guards ExpressionV1 title/body/footer copy across renderer, firmware, catalog, layout, priority, and generated PBM fixtures so WBA target glue cannot fork user-visible text.
portable_invariants.expression_input_source_matrix: tools/verify_expression_input_source_matrix.py guards boot, diagnostic, settings, status, battery, recording, interaction, and OTA input source coverage for WB55 and WBA adapters.
portable_invariants.expression_layout_contract: tools/verify_expression_layout_contract.py guards ExpressionV1 title/body/footer copy against truncation and overlap on supported screen variants.
portable_invariants.expression_priority_matrix: tools/verify_expression_priority_matrix.py guards every current ExpressionV1 face/signal pair, including lower-priority blocking, settings sleepy, battery recovered, duplicate suppression, and transient recovery behavior.
portable_invariants.expression_visual_contract: tools/verify_expression_visual_contract.py guards every ExpressionV1 PBM against blank, overfilled, or visually duplicate faces before target transport changes.
portable_invariants.screen_runtime_snapshot: comp_epaper_screen_runtime_snapshot aggregates expression, display queue, and panel adapter stats snapshots without target dependencies.
portable_invariants.target_capability_profile: tools/verify_expression_target_capabilities.py keeps WB55 as the validation target, WBA55 as the shared safe baseline, and WBA65 expansion behind explicit target capability flags without changing common screen limits.
portable_invariants.wba_cube_dependency_preflight: CubeWBA dependency preflight docs/validation/companion-screen-wba-cube-dependency-preflight.json records whether third_party/STM32CubeWBA exists and keeps WBA status DRAFT_PRE_PORT until a separate CubeWBA project and WBA build wrapper land.
portable_invariants.wba_display_scheduler_scaffold: WBA display scheduler scaffold screen_scheduler_stm32wba.h/.c provides callback-only display task wakeup, expression tick timer, and now_ms boundaries without WB55 UTIL_SEQ/HW_TS details.
portable_invariants.wba_panel_target_scaffold: WBA panel target adapter scaffold panel_target_stm32wba.h/.c defaults to dry-run through companion_epaper_panel_stm32wba_init and binds a WBA55/WBA65 target-owned refresh callback through companion_epaper_panel_stm32wba_bind without WB55 pin facts or WB55 build integration.
portable_invariants.wba_screen_assets_scaffold: WBA screen-assets scaffold screen_assets_stm32wba.h/.c binds a target-owned logical-partition read callback to comp_asset_store_t as external NOR, checks every read against partition_size, and keeps addresses, storage peripherals, pins, erase, and activation out of portable resource code.
portable_invariants.wba_screen_gatt_scaffold: WBA screen GATT scaffold screen_gatt_stm32wba.h/.c preserves CardWriteV1/CardStatusV1/SettingsV1, settings clear recovery, accepted and final CardStatusV1 identity, settings_sleepy_screen_status, and screen_expression_status without WB55 STM32_WPAN or companion_gatt_stm32wb details.
portable_invariants.wba_touch_target_scaffold: WBA FT6336 touch target scaffold touch_target_stm32wba_ft6336.h/.c binds 7-bit probe/register-read callbacks for WBA55/WBA65 and reuses comp_ft6336_decode_touch_report without CubeWBA HAL or WB55 pin facts.

required_new_artifacts.acceptance: Separate CubeWBA project; do not retarget the WB55 Cube project in place.

Records whether third_party/STM32CubeWBA is present, keeps WBA status DRAFT_PRE_PORT while the CubeWBA dependency/build wrapper is missing, and passes verify_expression_wba_cube_dependency_preflight.py.
Scriptable build wrapper analogous to tools/build_nucleo_bringup.ps1.
Preserves UUIDs, payload layouts, CardStatusV1 meanings, and settings_sleepy_screen_status behavior.

Initial WBA55/WBA65 screen GATT scaffold exists, exposes companion_epaper_stm32wba_screen_gatt_accept_card_write, preserves screen_expression_status identity rules, and passes verify_expression_screen_gatt_stm32wba.py before CubeWBA service integration is added.
Wakes the WBA display task and feeds comp_epaper_expression_state_tick().

Initial WBA55/WBA65 display scheduler/timer scaffold exists, exposes companion_epaper_stm32wba_schedule_expression_tick, stays callback-only, and passes verify_expression_screen_scheduler_stm32wba.py before CubeWBA scheduler integration is added.
Initial WBA55/WBA65 target-named scaffold defaults to dry-run, binds only a target-owned refresh callback, and passes verify_expression_panel_target_stm32wba.py before real transport is added.
Wired only through comp_epaper_panel_refresh_fn_t and keeps SPI/GPIO/BUSY code out of portable files.

Initial WBA55/WBA65 screen-assets scaffold binds a target-owned logical external-NOR partition reader, checks every read against partition_size, and passes verify_expression_screen_assets_stm32wba.py before CubeWBA storage integration is added.
Initial WBA55/WBA65 FT6336 scaffold uses 7-bit probe/register-read callbacks, reuses the portable decoder, and passes verify_touch_target_stm32wba_ft6336.py before CubeWBA I2C integration is added.
Includes screen_expression_status six-face baseline plus card_write and settings_sleepy_screen_status final rendered/ok evidence with --expect-real-panel.
Passes verify_expression_panel_evidence_record.py --record only after real panel facts and visual evidence are filled.

target_assumptions.budget_rule: Design to WBA55-safe protocol, queue, and memory limits unless a target capability explicitly enables expansion.
